input.message: This is a follow-up to the same fictional cold pickup meal I reported yesterday. Someone offered a credit, but I do not have a receipt showing it was issued. Please reply here and do not call me. I am not placing another order.

questions: What date and approximate time was the original cold pickup meal?
What name or order reference was the original order placed under?
Who offered the credit and what amount or form was discussed, if you recall?
result.reply: Hello — thank you for following up here, and I understand: no call, reply in writing only, and no new order. I hear your concern that a credit was offered for yesterday's fictional cold pickup meal, but you don't have a receipt showing it was issued. An offer is not the same as an issued credit, so I've flagged this for our team to verify what was recorded and reply back here with what they find. I'm sorry for the trouble with that meal.
